categories.main_business_segments: Skyworth Group operates primarily in four major business sectors: Smart Household Appliances, Smart Systems Technology, New Energy, and Modern Services. The Smart Household Appliances segment includes smart TVs, smart white appliances, and internet connection services. The Smart Systems Technology segment covers home access systems, automotive electronic systems, and other electronic products. The New Energy segment focuses on photovoltaic power stations and energy storage solutions, while Modern Services include property development, maintenance, logistics, and financial services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes AI-driven technologies, including AI large-model technology for smart TVs (Coocaa AIOS), Mini LED backlight control, AI picture quality chips, and sound enhancement algorithms. It employs intelligent manufacturing with fully automated production lines for photovoltaic modules and integrates digital and low-carbon technologies. The company also invests in multi-modal AI applications, XR/AI glasses, and automotive smart display systems, leveraging advanced R&D capabilities and proprietary technology development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Skyworth serves a diverse customer base including consumers of smart household appliances, telecommunications operators for smart systems technology, residential and commercial users for photovoltaic products, and clients requiring modern services such as property and logistics. Key markets include retail consumers, industrial and commercial sectors, and telecommunications providers. The Group also collaborates with internet enterprises and local brands to enhance market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations span Mainland China, other Asian regions (including Hong Kong, Vietnam, Indonesia, India), Europe, Americas, Africa, and Oceania. Mainland China remains the primary market, accounting for approximately 76% of revenue, with overseas markets contributing around 24%. The company has established localized teams and sales channels in major overseas markets including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, Mexico, and South Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Skyworth operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and sales of consumer electronics and photovoltaic products. It also engages in upstream activities such as R&D and production of photovoltaic modules, inverters, and energy storage systems. The Group manages supply chain coordination through specialized teams to enhance resource allocation and market responsiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes innovation driven by AI and digital transformation, focusing on integrating AI technologies into smart home ecosystems and expanding AI applications in smart devices. It invests in R&D for high-end differentiated products, multi-modal AI, XR/AI glasses, and automotive displays. The company also advances photovoltaic technology, energy storage solutions, and smart manufacturing capabilities, while pursuing internationalization and diversification strategies.
categories.revenue_model: Skyworth generates revenue mainly through product sales of smart TVs, household appliances, smart systems technology products, and photovoltaic power stations. It also earns income from internet value-added services via the Coocaa system, property development and leasing, financial services, and after-sales maintenance. The Group leverages both direct sales and multi-channel retail including e-commerce platforms and collaborations with brands.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Skyworth positions itself as a leading player in the Chinese smart TV market, holding the top nationwide sales for 100-inch LCD TVs. It competes in smart household appliances, new energy, and smart systems technology sectors with a focus on high-end, differentiated products and AI integration. The Group faces competition in global markets but leverages its brand strength, technological innovation, and diversified product portfolio to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Skyworth reported revenue of RMB65.0 billion, a 5.8% decrease from the previous year, with profit attributable to owners at RMB568 million, down 46.9%. The Group maintains substantial assets totaling RMB70.0 billion and equity of RMB23.1 billion. Despite short-term pressures, the company shows steady growth in smart household appliances and overseas markets, with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D to support future expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Skyworth emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and AI-enabled smart products that enhance user experience through superior picture and sound quality, ultra-thin designs, and smart home integration. Its photovoltaic products offer customized, aesthetically pleasing, and efficient energy solutions. The Group differentiates itself by combining hardware with internet content services, leveraging AI and digital technologies to build a comprehensive smart home ecosystem and sustainable green energy solutions.
